title: Looking Around
author: Pr1nted
$comment: The idle piece: stiller and more neutral than Creator, which is what separates them. Sitting at the low corner of the space means it never beats the theme on the menu or during a war, but it trades places with Creator over the map and the editor -- close enough in mood that the repeat penalty alternates them, far enough apart that each still has a home.
